message:
Mock test single avatar interaction with elevenlabs and zonos

I'm addressing the issue: https://github.com/Reekomer/aafactory/issues/7
In this PR im adressing only the first point, which is to mock the chat interaction.

So I've created a test for single avatar interaction using pytest-mock.
It is running two tests, one for elevenLabs and one for zonos.
More over i make sure to clear chat history before every test.
I added "print" statements for better debugging too.
Locally the test is passing.

Note: I meant to create a PR within the [branch of the original issue. ](https://github.com/Reekomer/aafactory/tree/7-the-chat-history-doesnt-reset-when-loading-new-avatar) but messed up somewhere. Let me know if this is ok, or i should delete this and create a new PR.
target_issue: aafactory/src/tests/test_chat/test_mock_chat.py: The test never calls `send_request_to_llm` — the actual function under test. It directly invokes the mocked `chat_interface.send_request_to_open_ai` and then asserts against the return value the mock was configured to produce. No real application logic is exercised, so the test does not validate the behaviour it claims to test.
notes: Under the DOSR policy, this documented finding requires reject (Jakub's pilot). PR title + description become the commit message.
